sloka: आत्मानमनुतिष्ठ त्वं स्वभावेन नरर्षभ ।निशाम्य तु शुभं वृत्तं पितुर्दशरथस्य न: ॥ २.१०५.४५॥
transliteration: ātmānamanutiṣṭha tvaṁ svabhāvena nararṣabha ।niśāmya tu śubhaṁ vṛttaṁ piturdaśarathasya na: ॥ 2.105.45॥

translations.english: O best of men, having seen the auspicious life of our father Dasaratha and his conduct, you also stick to your own duty.
